The assistant’s answer is incorrect and poorly reasoned. The problem requires understanding that at sunrise the sun is in the east, so a pole’s shadow will fall to the west. If Suresh is facing the pole, his right side is indeed to the west, so the shadow falls to his right, meaning the shadow points west. The assistant incorrectly concluded east, misinterpreting the right-hand direction and ignoring the sun’s position. The explanation is also vague and does not address the key geographic facts.  

Rating: [[2]]
